data.name: Aura of Sin
data.description: Your weapons are treated as evil-aligned for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction. Any attack made against an enemy within 10 feet of your is treated as evil-aligned for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction. This ability functions only while you remain conscious, not if you are unconscious or dead.
